issues.message: Quantifier "*" repeats an item that can match the empty string: an empty iteration matches nothing more.
Alternation branches "\\\\["\\\\bfnrt\\/]" and "\\\\u[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}" have overlapping character sets, which may cause unnecessary backtracking.
issues.hint: Consider using atomic groups (?>...) to prevent backtracking. Do not reorder overlapping alternatives as it changes match semantics.
